text:
Situation: Bupivacaine hydrochloride has been on the FDA shortage list since 2018-02-20 and remains current as of 2026-10-21. Hospira, Inc., a Pfizer Company, is among the listed manufacturers. Our Corvale Lakeside and Corvale General sites hold Hospira-labeled 2.5 mg/mL 10 mL vials (NDC 00409115901) linked to label set 02a845c3. Corvale East holds 4.6 days of the 2.5 mg/mL 10 mL presentation. Corvale Lakeside holds approximately 20 days and Corvale General holds approximately 19 days of the same presentation.

Why (FDA record): Label 02a845c3 names Hospira, Inc. plants at FEI 1021343 and FEI 1925262 as registered manufacturing sites. FDA inspection 976095 at FEI 1925262 ended 2016-06-08 with an OAI classification, 622 days before the shortage posting. A Warning Letter was issued to FEI 1925262 on 2017-02-14, 371 days before the posting.

Our position: Internal inventory redistribution can improve coverage at Corvale East without dropping other sites below two weeks. External purchases from manufacturers not on the FDA shortage list are available but require buyer execution and committee awareness.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 19 vials of 2.5 mg/mL 10 mL from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East — approved by pharmacy director (transfer request).
2. Transfer 85 vials of 2.5 mg/mL 10 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East — approved by pharmacy director (transfer request).
3. Evaluate purchase from Meitheal Pharmaceuticals Inc — executed by buyer; inform committee of procurement status.
4. Evaluate purchase from Anthea Pharma Private Limited — executed by buyer; inform committee of procurement status.
5. Evaluate purchase from B. Braun Medical Inc. — executed by buyer; inform committee of procurement status.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or formulary substitutions at this time; those decisions rest with treating clinicians and the committee.
